title: Government Scheme Intelligence Extraction Schema
description: Schema for extracting structured, evidence-grounded information from government welfare and scholarship scheme documents.

document_metadata.description: Metadata concerning the source document and extraction process.

document_id.description: Unique identifier for the ingested document.

source_type.description: Format or source type of the document (e.g., PDF, HTML, OCR_PDF).

source_identifier.description: Source file path, URL, or document filename.

extraction_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when extraction was performed.

scheme_name.description: Official name of the government scheme or scholarship.

implementing_authority.description: Government ministry, department, or administrative agency responsible for implementing the scheme.

target_beneficiaries.description: Target demographic or group eligible for the scheme.

education_level.description: Required education level or enrollment status.

age_criteria.description: Age limits or age-based eligibility constraints.

income_criteria.description: Annual family income thresholds or financial status eligibility requirements.

academic_criteria.description: Academic performance criteria, marks percentage, or GPA requirements.

category_criteria.description: Social category, caste, or reservation criteria.

domicile_criteria.description: State residency, regional domicile, or citizenship requirements.

benefit_type.description: Type of financial or material benefit provided.

benefit_amount.description: Monetary value, stipend rate, or financial assistance details.

application_url.description: Official website link or portal URL for scheme application.

required_documents.description: List of certificates, identity proofs, or documents required during application.

application_deadline.description: Closing date, last date for submission, or timeline for scheme applications.

Locator.description: Flexible location reference for document provenance.

page.description: Page number in a multi-page document.

section.description: Section header or section title in the document.

document_location.description: Specific document location, paragraph identifier, or snippet position.

url.description: Web URL or DOM selector for HTML sources.

source_reference.description: Equivalent source reference or file locator identifier.

EvidenceItem.description: Supporting evidence excerpt and source location citation.

text.description: Verbatim text snippet extracted from the source document supporting the field claim.

EvidenceAwareField.description: Consistent evidence-aware container for an extracted domain field.

value.description: Extracted field value (string, array of strings, or null if missing/not_found).

evidence.description: List of supporting evidence items extracted from the source document.

confidence.description: Confidence score between 0.0 and 1.0 for the extracted claim.

verification_status.description: Verification status of the extracted field.
